headline: Turkish Girl Group Manifest Plays First London Concert

sentences.text: A popular Turkish girl band came to London this year.
Six young women sing and dance in the group Manifest.
They played their first big British show at Wembley Arena.
The music group started on a television show last year.
Now millions of people listen to their songs every month.
The Turkish group Manifest performed their first London concert at Wembley Arena.
Six members formed the band last year through a TV talent contest.
They sang in London because they wanted to reach an international audience.
Their new English song TRALALA topped an online video chart very quickly.
The singers hope they will perform on even bigger stages in future.
They also met famous singer Dua Lipa at a festival in Kosovo.
The Turkish girl group Manifest recently performed their first concert in the United Kingdom.
Six members created the group last year after participating in a television music competition.
They have now attracted more than six million monthly listeners on a music platform.
While visiting London, the group released a new English song that reached top charts.
The band members met hundreds of UK fans during a special meeting in London.
They hope to maintain their Turkish identity while building a large international fan base.
The Turkish music group Manifest has made their United Kingdom debut at Wembley Arena in London.
The six-member band was established last year through a competitive television talent program in Turkey.
Guidance was provided by established Turkish pop stars during their television contest appearance last year.
Since then, the ensemble has accumulated over six million monthly listeners on digital streaming services.
Their first English-language track topped music video charts shortly after its international release in London.
Band member Hilal Yelekçi stated that the group intends to perform at major global music festivals.
Despite international expansion, the musicians emphasized their desire to preserve their native Turkish cultural roots.
Following a rapid rise to prominence in Turkey, the six-member girl group Manifest recently delivered their debut performance in London.
The band gathered at Wembley Arena, rehearsing synchronized choreography alongside backup dancers ahead of their milestone British showcase.
Formed through the Turkish reality talent competition Big5 Türkiye, the ensemble benefited from mentorship by established domestic pop icons.
Their momentum has expanded rapidly across streaming platforms, where they now command more than six million monthly listeners.
During their stay in the British capital, the group released their debut English single, which swiftly climbed online video rankings.
Beyond London, the group met international star Dua Lipa backstage before performing at her Sunny Hill Festival in Kosovo.
Band members expressed a clear ambition to headline major international stages while encouraging global audiences to learn Turkish lyrics.
Connecting with local supporters at a London signing event, the musicians signaled their intent to inspire young women worldwide.
